Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

rfm 0.5.1

CRAN release: 2026-11-15

Bug fixes

  • Corrected the customer-scoring return documentation and segment-summary plot title documentation.
  • The package now requires dplyr 1.1.0 or later, matching the imported join API.
  • Financial and fractional median plot labels now retain two decimal places instead of rounding to whole numbers; customer and order counts keep integer labels.
  • Segment summary charts now show negative revenue and average order value, including all-negative data, with room for their labels.
  • Interactive median and scatter hover text now names the selected metrics correctly.
  • Deprecated scatter and histogram wrappers now forward axis labels, titles and print_plot correctly and name their existing replacements.
  • Segment names such as "1" are now assigned correctly, preserving first-match precedence and assigning unmatched customers to "Others".
  • Heatmaps now preserve an observed missing monetary mean as NA, filling only absent score combinations with zero.
  • Automatic RFM bins now use right-closed quantile intervals without adding one to cut points, so currency conversions preserve monetary scores. Customers near a quantile boundary can receive different recency, frequency or monetary scores and segments; custom thresholds keep their lower-inclusive rule.
  • Transaction scoring now keeps only metadata that is constant within each customer and names dropped columns in a message, preserving customer totals.
  • Customer scoring now rejects duplicated customer IDs instead of multiplying rows and totals.
  • rfm_table_customer() now accepts either a date or a day-count recency column, with or without a recency_days column present (#111).
  • rfm_table_customer_2() now runs instead of failing because of a missing argument (#112).
  • rfm_table_order() and rfm_table_customer() now support different bin counts for recency, frequency and monetary; the threshold table is padded with NA to the longest dimension (#113). Segment definitions must fit the bin counts, as scores above the number of bins for a dimension never occur.
  • rfm_heatmap_data() and rfm_plot_heatmap() now work with custom threshold vectors, and missing recency levels are no longer placed in the frequency column (#114).

rfm 0.5.0

CRAN release: 2026-10-16

This is a maintenance and trust restoration release.

Lifecycle Notice

  • rfm is now in maintenance mode: it will keep receiving fixes, and a successor package is in development.

Trust & CRAN Compliance Fixes

  • Completely removed unsolicited network checks (available.packages()), update prompts, and runif() lottery from .onAttach(). Package attachment is now 100% offline and instantaneous.
  • Fixed report template corruption in rfm_create_report(): changed file.rename() to safe file.copy() (copy-only-if-missing), preserving user modifications and leaving the package installation template intact.
  • Eliminated all runtime interactive install.packages() calls in rfm_create_report() and rfm_launch_app(). Functions now throw polite, structured, and informative errors via cli::cli_abort() in both interactive and non-interactive sessions.
  • Promoted cli to Imports.
  • Trimmed Imports by demoting heavy visualization packages (plotly, gganimate, treemapify, and xplorerr) to Suggests, adding gifski to Suggests.
  • Added runtime guards at all public entrypoints for optional interactive and animated features.
  • Cleaned legacy test graphics artifacts (tests/figs/, tests/testthat/Rplots.pdf).
